name: task_agent_output_synthesize
content: Synthesize the reusable task-scoped agent output from the following structured bundle.
1. Choose exactly one `media_type` from `allowed_media_types` in the bundle. Prefer `preferred_media_type` unless another allowed type is clearly better.
2. Produce a compact reusable same-task output.
3. Preserve the most important task state, result facts, and source output lineage.
4. Prefer stable machine-readable fields over narrative commentary.
5. When the chosen `media_type` is `application/json`, use the preferred top-level keys when justified by the bundle: status, summary, result_facts, reusable_state, important_outputs, lineage.
6. Include only information justified by the bundle.
Respond with ONLY valid JSON using this envelope shape:
If you choose a text format, set `body_text` instead of `body_json`.

variables.name: bundle_section
variables.description: Structured task-agent synthesis bundle wrapped in <synthesis_bundle> tags
